name: Cloak of Elvenkind
description: A grey-green hooded cloak whose colour shifts to match whatever is behind it.
body:
## What it does

With the hood up, the cloak takes on the colours around you. Anyone looking for you has a hard time of it, and you hide far more easily. Raising or lowering the hood takes an action.

advantages.note: to hide, with the hood up

features.name: Camouflage
features.text: With the hood up, Wisdom (Perception) checks to see you have disadvantage.
